admin.required.title: Administrator rights needed
admin.required.body: Applying changes writes to areas of Windows that are protected: the registry machine hive, services and power schemes. GhostEye will restart with administrator rights so it can do that. Your settings and change history are kept.
info.restart: Requires a restart to take effect.
info.reversible: Fully reversible from the Change History.
info.advanced: Advanced: situational trade-off, not part of any preset.
tweak.perf.power-plan-high.details: Activates the Windows "High performance" power scheme (powercfg). The CPU stays at higher performance states instead of throttling down. Uses more power: on laptops battery life drops. The previous plan is restored on undo.
tweak.perf.foreground-priority.details: Sets HKLM\...\PriorityControl\Win32PrioritySeparation = 0x26: short, variable scheduler quanta that favour the window you are using. Background tasks get slightly less CPU time.
tweak.perf.visual-effects.details: Switches Visual Effects to "custom" and turns off menu/taskbar animations, list shadows, translucent selection and Aero Peek (HKCU Explorer, Desktop, DWM keys). Windows looks plainer but feels snappier on weak GPUs.
tweak.perf.startup-cleanup.details: Disables startup entries of common updaters, helpers and launchers (Steam, Discord, Spotify, Adobe, Java…) through the StartupApproved flag, exactly like Task Manager. Programs are not uninstalled and the entry is kept, so it can be re-enabled at any time from the Startup page.
tweak.perf.memory-compression.details: Runs Disable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression. Windows stops compressing RAM pages: less CPU used, but more writes to the page file when memory is full. Only worth it with 16 GB+ and plenty of free RAM.
tweak.perf.storage-optimize.details: Checks that TRIM is enabled (fsutil DisableDeleteNotify = 0) and that the scheduled drive optimisation task is on. Keeps SSD write speed stable over time.
tweak.perf.ultimate-plan.name: Ultimate Performance power plan
tweak.perf.ultimate-plan.desc: Unlocks and activates the hidden Ultimate Performance scheme
tweak.perf.ultimate-plan.details: Duplicates the hidden scheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 with powercfg and activates it. It removes micro power-saving latencies (core parking, idle states). Meant for desktops: on laptops battery life drops noticeably. Undo restores your previous plan.
tweak.gaming.game-mode.details: Sets AutoGameModeEnabled and AllowAutoGameMode = 1 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar. Windows gives the running game priority and postpones updates and notifications while you play.
tweak.gaming.disable-game-bar.details: Sets GameDVR\AppCaptureEnabled = 0 and turns off GameConfigStore capture. The Xbox Game Bar overlay and its capture hooks stop running in games.
tweak.gaming.gpu-scheduling.details: Sets HKLM\...\GraphicsDrivers\HwSchMode = 2. The GPU manages its own memory queue, reducing latency and CPU overhead. Needs a recent GPU/driver (WDDM 2.7+) and a restart.
tweak.gaming.fullscreen-opt.details: Writes the GameConfigStore fullscreen (FSE) behaviour values so games run in true exclusive fullscreen instead of the optimised borderless mode. Can lower input lag; Alt+Tab becomes slower.
Sets GameDVR\HistoricalCaptureEnabled = 0. Windows stops continuously recording the last minutes of gameplay in the background, freeing GPU encoder and disk.
tweak.gaming.mouse-latency.details: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision" (MouseSpeed and thresholds under HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse). Cursor movement becomes 1:1 with the physical mouse.
tweak.network.dns-optimized.details: Sets the DNS servers (IPv4, plus IPv6 for the quick-choice resolvers) of the connected adapters that have a gateway to the resolver chosen on the Network page. Virtual adapters with no route out are left alone. Faster lookups with many ISPs. Not applicable on PCs joined to a company domain. Undo restores the previous servers, or automatic DHCP.
tweak.network.tcp-optimize.details: Runs netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal. Only applicable if another tool changed it: a disabled or restricted receive window limits download speed.
tweak.network.adapter-power-off.details: Sets PnPCapabilities on each physical network adapter class key so Windows can no longer power the adapter down to save energy, avoiding short drops and ping spikes. Needs a restart.
tweak.network.dns-doh.details: Registers the DoH template of the resolver chosen on the Network page (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard or OpenDNS) if Windows does not know it yet, and sets DohFlags = 1 ("on, automatic template", as in Settings) for its addresses on every connected adapter. Works together with "Optimised DNS". On networks that block DoH (some offices, hotels, captive portals) lookups can fail: undo it there. Undo removes exactly what was added.
tweak.network.gaming-latency.details: Sets NetworkThrottlingIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF and SystemResponsiveness = 10 under Multimedia\SystemProfile, and TcpAckFrequency = 1 plus TCPNoDelay = 1 on the TCP/IP interface of each physical adapter. Lower and steadier ping in online games while music or video play in the background. Takes effect after a restart; undo restores every previous value.
tweak.network.delivery-optimization.deta: Sets the DODownloadMode = 0 policy under Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization ("HTTP only"): updates still come from Microsoft, but Windows no longer uploads them to other PCs on your network or on the internet. Undo removes the policy.
tweak.privacy.telemetry.details: Policy HKLM\...\DataCollection: AllowTelemetry = 0 and DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications = 1. Diagnostic data is reduced to the minimum your Windows edition allows (Home/Pro keep "Required").
tweak.privacy.advertising-id.details: Sets HKCU\...\AdvertisingInfo\Enabled = 0. Apps can no longer read your advertising ID to profile you across apps. You still see ads, just not personalised ones.
tweak.privacy.activity-history.details: Policy HKLM\...\Windows\System: PublishUserActivities and UploadUserActivities = 0. Windows stops recording the apps and files you open and stops syncing them to your Microsoft account.
tweak.privacy.windows-tips.details: Turns off ContentDeliveryManager values (suggested apps, Start suggestions, lock screen tips, silent app installs). No more promoted apps appearing in Start by themselves.
tweak.privacy.auto-feedback.details: Sets HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules NumberOfSIUFInPeriod and PeriodInNanoSeconds = 0. Windows stops popping up feedback surveys.

services.backup.hint: A copy of the state of every service and task on this page. If you switched something on or off by mistake, restore a backup to go back exactly to how it was. GhostEye takes an automatic one before the first change of each session.
services.backup.empty: No backups yet. Create one before changing services.
services.backup.restore.title: Restore this backup?
services.backup.restore.body: Services and tasks will go back to their state of {0}. An automatic backup of the current state is taken first, so this restore can be undone too.
services.backup.restored: Backup restored: {0} items back to the saved state.
services.backup.delete.title: Delete this backup?
services.backup.delete.body: The backup of {0} will be permanently deleted.
services.error.notInstalled: This service does not exist on this PC.
services.error.notApplied: Windows did not accept the change. Try again as administrator.
services.error.notAppliedElevated: Windows did not apply the change. The service may be managed by a group policy or another program.
services.error.protected: This item is protected by Windows and cannot be changed, even as administrator.

services.highRisk.body:

svc.DiagTrack.name: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
svc.DiagTrack.desc: Collects and sends diagnostic data to Microsoft.
svc.DiagTrack.details: The main Windows telemetry service. Disabling it stops usage data being uploaded and saves some CPU and disk activity. Windows Update and the Store keep working.
svc.dmwappushservice.name: WAP Push Message Routing
svc.dmwappushservice.desc: Routes device-management push messages; also used by telemetry.
svc.RetailDemo.name: Retail Demo
svc.RetailDemo.desc: Only used on PCs displayed in shops.
svc.MapsBroker.name: Downloaded Maps Manager
svc.MapsBroker.desc: Updates offline maps for the Maps app.
svc.Fax.name: Fax
svc.Fax.desc: Sends and receives faxes through a fax modem.
svc.RemoteRegistry.name: Remote Registry
svc.RemoteRegistry.desc: Lets other computers edit this PC's registry over the network. A security risk on home PCs.
svc.WerSvc.name: Windows Error Reporting
svc.WerSvc.desc: Sends crash reports to Microsoft. Set to start only when needed.
svc.wisvc.name: Windows Insider Service
svc.wisvc.desc: Only needed if you are in the Windows Insider programme.
svc.WpcMonSvc.name: Parental Controls
svc.WpcMonSvc.desc: Enforces Microsoft Family restrictions. Keep it if you use Family Safety.
svc.lfsvc.name: Geolocation Service
svc.lfsvc.desc: Provides your location to apps. Maps, weather and Find my device need it.
svc.PhoneSvc.name: Phone Service
svc.PhoneSvc.desc: Telephony state for Phone Link and cellular PCs.
svc.XblAuthManager.name: Xbox Live Auth Manager
svc.XblAuthManager.desc: Signs in to Xbox services. Needed by Game Pass and Xbox PC games.
svc.XblGameSave.name: Xbox Live Game Save
svc.XblGameSave.desc: Syncs cloud saves of Xbox PC games.
svc.XboxNetApiSvc.name: Xbox Live Networking
svc.XboxNetApiSvc.desc: Multiplayer networking for Xbox PC games.
svc.SysMain.name: SysMain (Superfetch)
svc.SysMain.desc: Preloads frequently used programs into RAM.
svc.SysMain.details: Useful on hard disks, much less on SSDs. On PCs with little RAM or constant disk activity disabling it can help; on others programs may open a little slower.
svc.WSearch.name: Windows Search
svc.WSearch.desc: Indexes files for instant search. Disabling it makes Start, Explorer and Outlook search slow.
svc.Spooler.name: Print Spooler
svc.Spooler.desc: Required for printing and PDF printers. Disable only if you never print.
task.appraiser.name: Compatibility Appraiser
task.appraiser.desc: Scans installed programs and sends compatibility telemetry.

task.autochkProxy.name: Autochk Proxy
task.autochkProxy.desc: Uploads disk-check data to the telemetry service.
task.diskDiagnostic.name: Disk Diagnostic Data Collector
task.siufDmClient.name: Feedback client
task.siufScenario.name: Feedback scenario download
task.werQueue.name: Error report queue

tools.ram.title: Memory
tools.ram.info: "Free memory" asks every program to release the RAM it is not actively using and, with administrator rights, clears the standby cache Windows keeps for files. Nothing is closed. Useful before starting a game on PCs with 8 GB or less; Windows refills the cache over time, which is normal.
tools.ram.resultNoStandby: {0} programs trimmed. Run as administrator to also clear the standby cache.
tools.processes.title: Heaviest programs
tools.processes.info: The 10 programs using the most memory right now, with their CPU use over one second. Windows components are hidden and cannot be ended. Ending a program closes it without saving.
tools.processes.confirm.title: End this program?
tools.processes.confirm.body: All windows of "{0}" will be closed immediately. Unsaved work is lost.
tools.processes.protected: This is a Windows component and cannot be ended.
tools.dns.title: DNS cache
tools.dns.info: Clears the list of website addresses Windows remembers (ipconfig /flushdns). Fixes sites that do not load after a DNS or network change. Harmless.
tools.files.title: Large files
tools.files.info: Lists files over 500 MB in your user folders (Downloads, Documents, Videos, Desktop…), largest first. Nothing is deleted unless you press Delete, and deleted files go to the Recycle Bin.
tools.files.confirm.title: Move this file to the Recycle Bin?
tools.files.confirm.body: "{0}" ({1}) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. Empty the bin to actually free the space.
page.disk.title: Disk Space
page.disk.subtitle: See what takes the space and remove duplicate files
page.health.title: PC Health
page.health.subtitle: Live monitor, disks, security, drivers and Windows repair
health.adminHint: Some data (disk temperature and wear, CPU temperature, BitLocker, Secure Boot) is available only when GhostEye runs as administrator.
health.monitor.title: Live monitor
health.monitor.info: Updated every 1.5 seconds from the same counters Task Manager uses. GPU temperature is read from NVIDIA drivers when present; CPU temperature comes from the motherboard's ACPI sensor, which needs administrator rights and is not exposed by every PC. Nothing is estimated: missing values stay empty.
health.disk.title: Disk health
health.disk.info: Windows' own health verdict for each drive, plus the reliability counters (temperature, SSD life left, power-on hours, unrecoverable read errors). A drive with read errors or little life left should be backed up and replaced.
health.disk.adminNeeded: Temperature, wear and power-on hours can only be read as administrator.
health.disk.notReported: This disk does not report its reliability counters (common with USB drives and some NVMe)
health.disk.predictFailure: The disk's own SMART check predicts a failure: back up your data and replace it
health.security.title: Security check
health.security.info: A quick look at the protections Windows should have on: antivirus, firewall, recent updates, disk encryption, Secure Boot and User Account Control. Nothing is changed here; use Windows Security to fix what is red.
health.security.antivirus.name: Antivirus
health.security.antivirus.desc: A registered antivirus with real-time protection on and up-to-date definitions.
health.security.firewall.name: Firewall
health.security.firewall.desc: Windows Firewall should be on for the domain, private and public profiles.
health.security.updates.name: Windows Update
health.security.updates.desc: Date of the last installed update. More than a month means security fixes are missing; a pending restart means updates are not active yet.
health.security.bitlocker.name: Disk encryption (BitLocker)
health.security.bitlocker.desc: Protects your files if the PC is lost or stolen. Not available on Windows Home.
health.security.secureboot.name: Secure Boot
health.security.secureboot.desc: Blocks malware that loads before Windows. Required by some anti-cheat systems (Valorant, Battlefield).
health.security.uac.name: User Account Control
health.security.uac.desc: Asks for confirmation before programs change the system. It should never be turned off.
health.driver.title: Drivers
health.driver.info: Drivers for graphics, network, audio, Bluetooth and storage, with their date. Drivers older than two years are flagged: for NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and Realtek the button opens the official download page; for everything else Windows Update › Optional updates is the safe source. GhostEye never downloads drivers from third-party sites.
health.repair.title: Repair Windows
health.repair.info: SFC checks every protected Windows file and replaces the damaged ones. DISM repairs the store SFC takes the good copies from, downloading them from Windows Update. If SFC says it could not fix everything, run DISM and then SFC again.
health.repair.hint: Use these when Windows crashes, apps fail to start or updates keep failing. Each check takes 5–20 minutes; you can keep using the PC.
health.repair.sfc.title: Check system files?
health.repair.sfc.confirm: SFC will scan all protected Windows files and repair the damaged ones. It takes 5–15 minutes.
health.repair.dism.title: Repair the component store?
health.repair.dism.confirm: DISM will check the Windows component store and download clean copies of damaged files from Windows Update. It needs internet and takes 10–20 minutes.
disk.map.title: Space map
disk.map.info: Measures the real size of every folder. Click a folder to open it and see what is inside; "Up" goes back. Folders you are not allowed to read are marked. The first scan of a whole drive can take a few minutes; folders already measured open instantly.
disk.map.hint: Pick a drive or your user folder to see which folders take the most space.
disk.dup.title: Duplicate files
disk.dup.info: Finds files over 1 MB with exactly the same content in your user folders (program data in AppData is skipped). Files are compared by size and then by a SHA-256 fingerprint, so same-name files with different content are never listed. The newest copy is kept by default; the others are moved to the Recycle Bin.
disk.dup.found: {0} groups of duplicates · {1} can be freed
disk.dup.keepOne.title: Keep at least one copy
disk.dup.keepOne.body: In at least one group every copy is selected. Leave one unticked so the file is not lost.
disk.dup.confirm.title: Move the selected copies to the Recycle Bin?
disk.dup.confirm.body: {0} files ({1}) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. One copy of each file is kept.
disk.dup.deleted: {0} copies moved to the Recycle Bin.
disk.dup.deletedPartial: {0} copies moved to the Recycle Bin, {1} could not be moved.
boost.title: Game Boost
boost.info: One click before playing: switches to the fastest power plan, pauses Windows Update downloads, closes the background programs you tick and frees memory. "Stop" puts everything back and can reopen the closed programs. Voice chat, overlays and anti-cheat are never closed. The state is saved, so even after a restart "Stop" restores your settings.
boost.noApps: No background program to close right now.
network.speed.title: Speed test
network.speed.info: Downloads up to 50 MB and uploads 15 MB to Cloudflare's public speed-test servers (speed.cloudflare.com), the nearest one to you. Each phase stops after about 12 seconds on slow lines. The test is only run when you press the button.
network.speed.failed: The test could not be completed: check your connection.
network.ping.title: Ping
network.ping.info: Sends 8 pings to each host and shows the average time, jitter (how much it varies) and lost packets. Under 50 ms is great for gaming, 50–100 ms is fine, above 100 ms or any loss causes lag. Game hosts are the public regional endpoints of those networks and approximate the in-game ping.
network.reset.title: Network reset
network.reset.info: Runs netsh winsock reset, netsh int ip reset (IPv4 and IPv6) and flushes the DNS cache. It repairs the network stack when the internet stops working after malware, VPNs or broken software. Static IP settings on the adapters may be reset. A restart is required.
network.reset.hint: Use it only if the internet does not work and the usual fixes did not help.
network.reset.body: The Windows network stack will be reset to its defaults. VPN and static IP settings may need to be configured again. Restart the PC afterwards.
network.reset.done: Network reset completed. Restart the PC to apply it.
settings.thirdParty.title: Third-party licences
settings.thirdParty.desc: GhostEye includes these fonts and libraries. Their licences allow redistribution; the full texts are below.
tweak.privacy.copilot.name: Copilot
tweak.privacy.copilot.desc: Turns off the built-in Copilot and hides its taskbar button
tweak.privacy.copilot.details: Policy TurnOffWindowsCopilot = 1 (HKCU and HKLM\...\WindowsCopilot) and Explorer\Advanced\ShowCopilotButton = 0. The separate Copilot app from the Store is a normal app: remove it from the Apps page.
tweak.privacy.recall.name: Recall and Click to Do
tweak.privacy.recall.desc: Stops Recall from saving screen snapshots (Copilot+ PCs)
tweak.privacy.recall.details: Policy HKCU and HKLM\...\WindowsAI: DisableAIDataAnalysis = 1 and DisableClickToDo = 1. The feature is not uninstalled, it just stops recording. On PCs without an NPU nothing changes.
tweak.privacy.widgets.name: Widgets and news
tweak.privacy.widgets.desc: Turns off the Widgets board and the MSN news feed
tweak.privacy.widgets.details: Policy HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh\AllowNewsAndInterests = 0. This is the documented method: the per-user TaskbarDa value has been protected by Windows since 2024.
tweak.privacy.start-web-search.name: Web search in Start
tweak.privacy.start-web-search.desc: Removes Bing results from Start menu search
tweak.privacy.start-web-search.details: Policy HKCU\...\Explorer\DisableSearchBoxSuggestions = 1 and Search\BingSearchEnabled = 0. Searching apps, files and settings still works and gets faster. Fully effective after Explorer restarts or the next sign-in.
tweak.privacy.start-ads.name: Ads in Start and on the lock screen
tweak.privacy.start-ads.desc: Hides recommended apps, account notifications and promotional tips
tweak.privacy.start-ads.details: Explorer\Advanced: Start_IrisRecommendations and Start_AccountNotifications = 0; ContentDeliveryManager: SubscribedContent-338388/338387 and RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled = 0. The lock screen wallpaper is unchanged.
tweak.privacy.edge.name: Microsoft Edge in the background
tweak.privacy.edge.desc: Stops Edge running in the background and reduces the data it sends
tweak.privacy.edge.details: Policy HKLM\...\Edge: StartupBoostEnabled, BackgroundModeEnabled, HubsSidebarEnabled, PersonalizationReportingEnabled, ShowRecommendationsEnabled and DiagnosticData = 0. Note: with any policy Edge shows "Managed by your organization"; that is expected.
tweak.privacy.inking-typing.name: Inking and typing personalization
tweak.privacy.inking-typing.desc: Stops collecting what you type and write for the personal dictionary
tweak.privacy.inking-typing.details: InputPersonalization: RestrictImplicitInkCollection and RestrictImplicitTextCollection = 1, TrainedDataStore\HarvestContacts = 0, Input\TIPC\Enabled = 0. On-screen keyboard suggestions become less personal.
tweak.privacy.tailored-experiences.name: Tailored experiences
tweak.privacy.tailored-experiences.desc: Microsoft stops using diagnostic data for targeted tips and ads
tweak.privacy.tailored-experiences.detai: Sets HKCU\...\Privacy\TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled = 0, the same switch as Settings › Privacy › Diagnostics.
tweak.privacy.location.name: Location services
tweak.privacy.location.desc: No app can read the PC's location
tweak.privacy.location.details: Sets ConsentStore\location\Value = "Deny" (HKLM), as Settings › Privacy › Location does. Maps, local weather, Find my device and automatic time zone stop working.
tweak.ui.classic-context-menu.name: Classic context menu
tweak.ui.classic-context-menu.desc: Right-click shows every entry at once, without "Show more options"
tweak.ui.classic-context-menu.details: Creates an empty HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-...}\InprocServer32: Explorer falls back to the Windows 10 menu. Needs a restart (or an Explorer restart). Reverting removes the key.
tweak.ui.file-extensions.name: Show file extensions
tweak.ui.file-extensions.desc: Shows .pdf, .exe, .jpg: also helps spot dangerous files
tweak.ui.file-extensions.details: Sets Explorer\Advanced\HideFileExt = 0. A file named "invoice.pdf.exe" shows up as what it is.
tweak.ui.end-task.name: "End task" in the taskbar
tweak.ui.end-task.desc: Close a frozen program by right-clicking its taskbar icon
tweak.ui.explorer-this-pc.name: File Explorer opens "This PC"
tweak.ui.explorer-this-pc.desc: Opens drives directly instead of Home
tweak.ui.explorer-this-pc.details: Sets Explorer\Advanced\LaunchTo = 1. Applies to new File Explorer windows.
tweak.ui.taskbar-left.name: Taskbar aligned left
tweak.ui.taskbar-left.desc: Start and icons on the left, as on Windows 10
tweak.ui.sticky-keys-shortcut.name: Accessibility key shortcuts
tweak.ui.sticky-keys-shortcut.desc: Shift five times, right Shift held or Num Lock held no longer pop up a prompt in games
tweak.ui.sticky-keys-shortcut.details: Clears only the shortcut bit (0x4) from the Flags of StickyKeys, Keyboard Response (Filter Keys) and ToggleKeys under Control Panel\Accessibility, and loads the new values into the current session right away, with no sign-out. The features themselves stay available in Settings; undo restores the previous values.
page.software.title: Software
page.software.subtitle: Install and update programs with winget
autoBoost.title: Automatic Game Boost
autoBoost.desc: Starts Game Boost when a game from your library opens and stops it when the game closes.
autoBoost.info: Games are found from what Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft Connect and the Xbox app record as installed; you can add others by hand. During an automatic boost GhostEye switches to the fastest power plan, closes the background programs ticked by default (never launchers such as EA app or Ubisoft Connect, which games need) and pauses Windows Update when it runs as administrator. Memory is not trimmed automatically: the game is still loading. GhostEye must be open or in the notification area.
autoBoost.none: No games found. Install games with Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft Connect or the Xbox app, or add an executable by hand.
autoBoost.add.title: Choose the game executable
autoBoost.backgroundHint: Works only while GhostEye is open. Turn on "Keep running in the background" in Settings to have it always ready.
autoBoost.notify.title: Automatic Game Boost
autoBoost.notify.startedClosed: Boost active for {0}: {1} background programs closed.
drift.card.title: {0} changes switched back
drift.card.body: These changes were applied with GhostEye but are no longer in effect: Windows updates often reset them. Re-apply them, or keep them as they are now.
drift.reappliedPartial: {0} changes applied again, {1} failed: see History for details.
drift.restart: Some take effect after a restart.
drift.notify.title: Changes undone by Windows
drift.notify.body: {0} changes made with GhostEye are no longer active. Open GhostEye to re-apply them.
drift.notify.clean: All changes applied with GhostEye are still in effect.
fps.title: FPS measurement
fps.info: Measures the real frame rate of a running game with Intel PresentMon, the tool used by hardware reviewers. It reads the frames the game presents through Windows event tracing: nothing is injected into the game, so it is safe with anti-cheat. Measure the same scene before and after applying changes: the average shows overall speed, the 1% low shows stutter. Needs administrator rights.
fps.noTargets: Start the game, then press Refresh.
fps.capturing: Measuring {0}… {1} s left. Keep playing the same scene.
fps.done: Average {0} FPS · 1% low {1} FPS · {2} ms per frame
fps.error.missingTool: The measurement tool could not be prepared. Check the free space and try again.
fps.error.noFrames: No frames recorded. Make sure the game is in the foreground and rendering (not paused or minimised) during the measurement.
maintenance.title: Automatic maintenance
maintenance.desc: Periodically deletes temporary files, old logs, crash dumps and error reports, and checks whether Windows undid any change. Browser caches, the Recycle Bin and update files are never touched. Runs while GhostEye is open or in the notification area.
maintenance.notify.title: Maintenance completed
maintenance.notify.body: {0} freed. All changes are still in effect.
maintenance.notify.bodyDrift: {0} freed. {1} changes were undone by Windows: open GhostEye to re-apply them.
profile.title: Profiles
profile.desc: Save the changes applied on this PC to a file and apply the same set on other PCs. The file contains only choices (tweaks, services, DNS), never personal data.
profile.export.title: Save profile
profile.import.title: Open profile
profile.import.confirmBody: Profile "{0}": {1} changes and {2} services. A restore point is created first and every change can be undone from History.
profile.appliedPartial: Profile applied: {0} changes and {1} services, {2} failed. See the log for details.
profile.error.invalid: This file is not a valid GhostEye profile.
profile.error.newer: This profile was made by a newer version of GhostEye. Update GhostEye to use it.
profile.cli: From a script: GhostEye.exe --apply-profile file.json --silent (exit code 0 = done).
profile.cli.notElevated: Run the command from an administrator prompt.
settings.background.desc: Closing the window leaves GhostEye in the notification area, so automatic Game Boost and maintenance keep working. Exit from the icon's menu.
software.install.title: Install programs
software.install.desc: Tick what you need and install everything in one go. Programs already installed are marked.
software.info: Installs and updates go through winget, Microsoft's package manager built into Windows. Installers come from the original publishers and winget checks their hash before running them; GhostEye never downloads an installer itself. Some installers ask for administrator confirmation.
software.unavailable: winget is not available on this PC. Install "App Installer" from the Microsoft Store, then press Refresh.
software.nothingSelected: Select at least one program that is not installed yet.
software.upgrades.title: Updates
software.upgrades.desc: Finds newer versions of the programs installed on this PC, including those not installed through GhostEye.
software.upgradeAll.title: Update all programs?
software.upgradeAll.body: {0} programs will be updated. Close them first: an installer cannot replace a program that is running.
software.updatingAll: Updating all programs… this can take several minutes.
software.upgradesLeft: {0} updates could not be installed: the programs may be running or need a restart.
tray.hint.title: GhostEye is still running
tray.hint.body: It stays in the notification area. Right-click the icon to exit.
history.detail.none: No details were recorded for this change (it was made with an older version of GhostEye).
history.delete.title: Delete this history entry?
history.delete.body: "{0}" will be removed from the history. Its changes had already been undone, so nothing changes on the PC.
history.delete.bodyActive: "{0}" will be removed from the history. {1} of its changes are still applied: they stay on the PC, but GhostEye will no longer be able to undo them from here.
history.clear.title: Clear the whole history?
history.clear.body: {0} entries will be deleted. All their changes had already been undone.
history.clear.bodyActive: {0} entries will be deleted. {1} changes are still applied: they stay on the PC, but GhostEye will no longer be able to undo them.
